text:
maria: CI red on #4567, unit tests failing on TestCacheEviction only. Build passed earlier, looks like a flaky. Anyone can retrigger without rebuilding the whole image?
ash: yep, we can do a light retry. use the ci CLI: `ci retry --pr 4567 --jobs unit --preserve-cache` — that skips image rebuild.
lee: small caveat: preserve-cache only works if the artifact cache key matches. if the failure is environment-related you might still need a full rebuild.
maria: thanks. quick question — is the command available to me or do I need oncall perms?
ash: you should be able to run it if you're in the CI group. otherwise ping @oncall.
lee: alternative if CLI isn't available: comment `@deploy-bot rerun unit --no-build` on the PR, bot will enqueue the job.
ci-bot: NOTE: `--preserve-cache` will keep docker layers and build artifacts for up to 2 hours from original run. If original run is older, cache may be invalidated.
maria: original run was ~30m ago, so safe. kicking it now.
maria: @deploy-bot rerun unit --no-build
deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Enqueued unit tests (matrix: linux-py39, linux-py310) — preserving cache. Job id: 987654.
maria: thanks — watching logs.
ash: if it flakes again, try targeted rerun of failing axis: `ci retry --job 987654 --only-failed` — that will only requeue the failing shard.
lee: and if you need to bisect: `ci bisect --pr 4567 --range HEAD~10..HEAD` will run a narrow binary search across commits to find suspect change. use cautiously (costly).
maria: unit job finished ✅ all green. mark PR as ready. thanks folks :tada:
ash: nice. if this recurs more than once, open a flaky-test ticket and add the failing run IDs, we'll quarantine it or add a retry wrapper.
lee: also adding `TestCacheEviction` to the flaky-tests dashboard so QA can watch trends.
ci-bot: reminder: for future no-build retries you can also use the web UI -> Job -> "Re-run only failed" button (preserves artifacts when possible).
maria: noted. closing thread.
